title: Avocado with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- avocado outer skin -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='27' ry='36' fill='#2e6b3a'/>
  <!-- lighter inner skin edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='23' ry='32' fill='#4c9a4f'/>
  <!-- avocado flesh -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='19' ry='28' fill='#c8d96a'/>
  <!-- inner flesh highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='42' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#e2ec8f' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- pit / face area -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='11' fill='#9b5a2b'/>
  <!-- pit highlight -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='52' r='4' fill='#c07a45' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='53' r='2.2' fill='#2b1a10'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='53' r='2.2' fill='#2b1a10'/>
  <!-- eye glints -->
  <circle cx='44.2' cy='52.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54.2' cy='52.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 60 Q50 66 56 60' stroke='#2b1a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='58' r='2.8' fill='#e88a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='58' r='2.8' fill='#e88a8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='48' y='14' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#7a4a22'/>
  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M52 16 Q62 10 66 16 Q60 20 52 16 Z' fill='#3f8f3a'/>
  <path d='M52 16 Q60 15 64 16' stroke='#2e6b3a' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
</svg>
